back: A line on a map joining places of equal height above sea level.
The difference in height between neighbouring contours; count the gaps, not the lines.
Spot height: dot with exact height. Trigonometrical station: triangle with height, a surveyed reference point.
Close = steep; wide = gentle; even = uniform; none over a wide area = flat.
Concave: steep top, gentle bottom (crowded contours high up). Convex: gentle top, steep bottom.
Valley Vs point uphill (upstream); spur Vs point downhill.
A low point on a ridge between two summits, shown by two sets of closed contours.
A long line of crowded contours (scarp slope) beside widely spaced contours (gentle dip slope).
